newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 24.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:

- After a night of joy over the release of 225 hostages, a cloud of fear hung on Monday over the Japanese Ambassador's residence in Lima, Peru, as negotiations between the government and Marxist guerrillas failed to liberate the 140 remaining captives.

- Now that the last of the 1996 Congressional races has been settled, some of the National Rifle Association's enemies in the gun control lobby say they're beginning to think the association is losing its firepower.

- New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani is preparing a broad plan to open up manufacturing areas to residential development while eliminating regulations that he thinks are discouraging housing construction in the city.
- Everyone connected with New York City's school system will be effected by the State Legislature's overhaul of school management last week.
